call_points.text: El Nino impacted the season, leading to lower interest in premium, high-value products due to rainfall deficits.
Cotton volumes remained flat YoY despite illegal cotton competition and lower overall acreage.
New cotton products' contribution to the portfolio rose significantly from 21.4% to 37.7%.
Maize volumes fell 36% in H1FY27, primarily due to a 30% drop in sowing acreage in Karnataka.
Export business grew to ₹33.07 Cr in H1FY27 from ₹12.56 Cr in the previous year.
H1FY27 EBITDA margin held steady at 30.48% compared to 30.32% in H1FY26.
Hybrid rice revenue in Q2 grew to ₹17.33 Cr from ₹2.37 Cr, driven by exports.
Management guides for 15% to 20% revenue growth in FY27, with volume driving majority of gains.
Management expects gross and operating margins to improve in FY27 due to slightly lower production costs.
Customer advances fell ₹75 to ₹80 Cr as company discouraged advances to avoid giving margin-diluting incentives.
Seed inventory levels across the industry remain elevated, preventing price increases in FY27.
Export business delivered ~90% growth during FY26 and 76% in Q4FY26, with performance expected to stay strong.
Buyback was paused due to working capital locked in inventory, and may be revisited in 3-5 months.
Management commentary audio link published for Q4 and FY26 audited standalone and consolidated results.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹107.11 Cr (+18.7% YoY), net loss to shareholders ₹27.81 Cr (against a loss of ₹22.94 Cr a year earlier).
Kaveri Seed published the audio link for its management commentary on Q4 and FY26 financial results.
Management hosted Q4 & FY26 concall guiding for 15-20% revenue growth in FY27 led by cotton volumes and lower unit production costs.
GUNDAVARAM VENKATA BHASKAR RAO, promoter, declared Kaveri Seed Company Limited’s shareholding unchanged at 31st March 2026 with no encumbrances.
Kaveri Seed Company received an ITAT hearing notice on June 2, 2026 regarding an appeal by the Income Tax Department against the deletion of a ₹73.25 Cr tax demand for AY 2020-21.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹244.14 Cr (+11.5% YoY), net loss to shareholders ₹8.78 Cr (against a loss of ₹15.43 Cr a year earlier).
Kaveri Seed reported a narrowed standalone Q2FY27 net loss of ₹3.21 Cr on 29.8% revenue growth, driven by a 2.6x surge in H1 exports.
